spanish: Torá una será al natural y al peregrino el peregrinante en medio de ustedes.

findings.issue: תּוֹרָה is a common noun (law/instruction), not a name; Torá leaves the lemma untranslated and capitalizes it as a title.

notes: The other tokens match: one, 3ms will-be, to the native and to the sojourner who sojourns, in your midst as ustedes.
